preconditions.description: The graph has n vertices (1 ≤ n ≤ 3·10^5) and m edges (n-1 ≤ m ≤ 3·10^5), ensuring connectivity.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= d <= 1 for d in d_list)
preconditions.description: Each vertex degree constraint di is either -1, 0, or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: not any(u == v for u, v in edges)

postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' (no solution) or a valid subset of edge indices (1-based, in input order).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(edge_indices := [int(x) for x in stdout.split()[1:]]) == int(stdout.split()[0]) and all(1 <= idx <= m for idx in edge_indices))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the first line is k (number of edges in subset), followed by k distinct edge indices in [1, m].

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (subset_edges := [edges[i-1] for i in edge_indices] and all((d_list[i] == -1 or (sum(1 for (u,v) in subset_edges if u == i+1 or v == i+1) % 2 == d_list[i])) for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: For every vertex i, if di ≠ -1, its degree modulo 2 in the subset graph equals di. If di = -1, no constraint is imposed.
